title: How I Cleaned Messy Sales Data with Python
description: A step-by-step walkthrough of cleaning a real-world messy sales dataset using pandas — handling nulls, duplicates, outliers, and formatting issues.
problem: Received a 50,000-row sales CSV with inconsistent date formats, missing customer IDs, duplicate entries, and mixed-case column names.
solution: Used pandas to build a systematic cleaning pipeline: standardize columns, drop duplicates, impute missing values, fix data types, and validate final output.
how: Started with df.info() and df.describe() for a quick audit. Used .fillna(), .drop_duplicates(), pd.to_datetime(), and .str.lower() to fix each issue layer by layer. Exported a clean version with version control notes.

title: Writing Better SQL Queries for Business Reports
description: Practical tips and patterns I use to write readable, efficient SQL queries that non-technical stakeholders can actually understand.
problem: Business analysts were getting confused by complex nested subqueries and inconsistent naming conventions in SQL reports.
solution: Adopted CTEs (Common Table Expressions) instead of subqueries, added meaningful aliases, and used consistent formatting across all queries.
how: Replaced all nested subqueries with WITH clauses for readability. Added comments to each CTE. Used CASE WHEN for business-friendly labels. Tested performance with EXPLAIN.

title: Building My First Power BI Dashboard
description: My experience building a sales KPI dashboard from scratch in Power BI — from data model to final publish — and the mistakes I made along the way.
problem: Had clean data in Excel but no way to share dynamic insights with stakeholders without emailing updated files manually.
solution: Connected Excel to Power BI, built a star schema data model, created DAX measures for KPIs, and published to Power BI Service for live sharing.
how: Used Power Query to transform and load data. Created a Date table for time intelligence. Wrote DAX for YoY growth, running totals, and dynamic titles. Used bookmarks for interactive report navigation.
tags: Power BI, DAX, dashboard, data model
